name: SleepioRx
short_description: FDA-cleared prescription digital therapeutic delivering cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (CBT-I) through mobile app-based video and audio lessons.
long_description: SleepioRx is an FDA-cleared prescription digital therapeutic that delivers guideline-recommended cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (CBT-I) through personalized video and audio lessons in a mobile app. Designed by sleep experts, the treatment helps patients understand unhealthy sleep patterns and address the thoughts and behaviors that sustain insomnia. The program has been tested in 26 clinical trials including 18 randomized controlled trials, demonstrating that up to 76% of patients achieve healthy sleep by post-treatment with benefits lasting 1 year or longer. As the first digital therapeutic to receive NICE guidance in the UK confirming clinical and cost effectiveness, SleepioRx is now reimbursable under Medicare with CMS billing codes effective January 2025.
one_liner: FDA-cleared CBT-I digital therapeutic for insomnia
best_for: and primary care providers treating patients with chronic insomnia who may benefit from non-pharmacological treatment
not_for: Patients with sleep apnea or other primary sleep disorders requiring medical intervention beyond behavioral therapy

pricing.notes: Reimbursable under Medicare Fee-for-Service and Medicare Advantage with CMS codes effective January 2025. Also available through employers and health plans like Comcast, Hartford, and NHS.

faqs.a: SleepioRx is an FDA-cleared prescription digital therapeutic that delivers cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (CBT-I) through personalized video and audio lessons in a mobile app.
In 26 clinical trials including 18 RCTs, up to 76% of SleepioRx patients achieved healthy sleep by post-treatment, with benefits lasting 1 year or longer after starting.
Yes, SleepioRx is reimbursable under Medicare Fee-for-Service and Medicare Advantage with CMS billing codes effective January 2025. It's also available through major employers and health plans.

faqs.q: What is the difference between SleepioRx and Sleepio?
faqs.a: SleepioRx is the FDA-cleared prescription version requiring a clinician prescription, while Sleepio is the wellness version sold directly to employers and health plans for their members.
